I used clickhouse-copier to migrate the data and found that the Datetime columns were actually eight hours apart.

But if I manually import it in the following way, the data is correct.
```
clickhouse-client -udefault -hB --query="select * from db.table1" --format=CSV> table1.csv

```
I read the log and thought clickhouse-copier was also insert after select, but the result was problematic. So I want to know the difference between clickhouse-copier's  and "select to csv then insert"
